messages:
Priya Singh: Quick sync 1: we need a lightweight migration banner + a minimal guide for teams using legacy v1 endpoints. Goal: low-friction update so customer apps don't break when we flip redirect.

Diego Morales: I can update Ruby + Go snippets. Should I keep examples synchronous-only or include streaming variants?

Nora White: Streaming variants would be great, but make them secondary. Primary quickstart should show the single-call pattern `client.responses.create({ model, input })` then link to streaming section.

Evan Li: Heads-up: ops will do a staged redirect (canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%). Docs should include a tiny checklist for canary owners (smoke tests, metrics to watch, rollback criteria).

Priya Singh: Exactly. Suggested canary checklist (short):
- smoke test id (created by CI)
- latency baseline (p50/p95)
- error rate threshold (>= 2x baseline triggers rollback)
- qualitative prompt checks (5 sample prompts)

DocsBot: banner-preview: "Important: /v1 endpoints will be redirected to v2 on 2025-06-15. See migration guide (draft)". Preview posted at https://redwood.docs/internal/banners/preview-1778883333

Diego Morales: Adding a quick mapping table in the Ruby doc for common param changes. Draft: `stream_callback` -> `on_delta`, `model_name` -> `model`. Will push a PR shortly.

Nora White: Please also include a note about model alias fallbacks. Example mapping in prose: "old alias `rwd-small` maps to `redwood-small-v2` (no behavioral change expected)". Link to model-swap page for edgecases.

Evan Li: CI-bot can you create the smoke job template and a canary test harness?

CI-bot: deploy-checks/1778883333: created job template `docs-migrate-canary-177888`. Assign on merge.

Priya Singh: One more: internal links. We have several docs referencing `/v1/embeddings` and `/v1/models`. Samir (infra) will need the redirect map. @Nora White, please enumerate the paths in your PR comment.

Nora White: Will do. I'll add a short JSON blob in the PR comment like:
```
[
  "/v1/models",
  "/v1/embeddings",
  "/v1/generate"
]
```
I won't paste all internal URLs, just the paths.

Diego Morales: For SDK README changes, propose we keep both snippets for one week post-redirect: a "Before" (v1) and "After" (v2) example with a small note: "If you rely on v1 alias names, expect redirects to v2 names."

Priya Singh: Good plan. Action owners: Diego 1 SDK PRs (ruby/go) + snippet dual state; Nora 1 migration guide + link list; Evan 1 canary checklist + metric thresholds; CI-bot 1 template created. We'll mark PRs with label `migration/v1-v2` and add the small checklist comment (owner, reviewer, smoke-test).

DocsBot: Suggested banner copy (short): "Deprecation notice: legacy v1 API endpoints will be redirected to v2 on 2025-06-15. Read the migration guide and update code samples."

Priya Singh: Thanks everyone. If you hit any surprising edgecases (esp. webhook payload changes or embed dim differences), flag here and we'll escalate to runtime team. Recheck tomorrow 10:30am PT in #docs. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
